episode_event_academy2026autumn/6801_103:
I want to pursue learning
unique to Pasio.
episode_event_academy2026autumn/6801_100:
I’m looking forward to all the new things I’ll
learn at Pasio Academy.

Feeling motivated, eh? I’m excited to hold a
battle studies class on Pasio, too!

I’ll keep up with your hot-blooded training
all the way to the end, Ms. Dendra!
episode_event_academy2026autumn/4001_100:
Osu! It’s the one, the only, the hot-blooded
Dendra!
Battle studies is all about Pokémon battles!

I’m gonna teach everyone here at
Pasio Academy, too!

I see. The schools in Paldea have a
structured approach to teaching Pokémon
battles.
I’d love to revisit the basics.

Aha! Now that’s what I’d expect from a Gym
Leader! You’ve got good instincts.
You know Bea, Ms. Dendra?

Yup! I heard about her after I arrived on
Pasio—including that she’s a master of
Galar karate!
I’m honored...
Hahaha! Don’t be so stiff!

Today you can relax. You’re in good hands,
and—

No, scratch that. Imagine we’re hanging on
to a Hariyama. Let your fighting spirits blaze!

Yes! I will press onward with every ounce of
strength in my body and soul!
I’ll give it my all, too!
Great attitude, everyone!

Today, I’ll be teaching you the battle studies
basics, as well as the secret to mastery:
physical training!

It takes stamina for a Trainer to last multiple
rounds of Pokémon battles!
I see!

To build stamina, you need muscle!
So first, let’s work out! Osu!
OK!
episode_event_academy2026autumn/4002_110:
Bea and the others embraced Dendra’s
hot-blooded lesson and ran all over Pasio.
episode_event_academy2026autumn/4002_100: OK, everyone! Let’s take a break!
I chose a harder route than usual, so rest up!
*pant pant*

I made a special nutritious drink for you to
share with your Pokémon! Help yourselves!

Post-exercise nutrition will help your
muscles grow!
Whoa!
It’s so good!

It tastes like something from a fancy café!
Did you make this?
Actually, Nurse Miriam helped me!
My first drink was, uh...
I tried my best, but it didn’t taste so good.

Hey there! Just checking in to see if
anyone’s hurt.
Speaking of which, look who’s here!

As a health teacher, I’ve gotta make sure
everyone gets good nutrition, you know?

I’ve got your back, Ms. Dendra. We’ll work
on your weak spots little by little!
Osu!
Ms. Miriam, can I ask you something?
Hm? Of course!
I’ve had a bit too many sweets recently...
How many have you had?
That shouldn’t be a problem!
R-really?
Yup! Just think of it as a treat!

While it’s good to have a nutritious diet,
one mustn’t be too strict.
I see. That’s a relief. Thank you!
Can you teach me how to make this drink?
You like it, huh? I’ll send you the recipe!
Whoa! Look at you all bonding so quick!

Nurse Miriam is an awesome teacher.
You can talk to her about anything!

You’re a great hot-blooded instructor too,
Ms. Dendra!

Just be careful not to get hurt, OK?
Good luck with your battle studies!
episode_event_academy2026autumn/4003_110:
Under Dendra’s direction, Bea and the others
climbed a rock face, stood under a waterfall,
and smashed tiles...
episode_event_academy2026autumn/4003_100:
Especially you, Bea! Just what I’d expect
from a Galar karate master!
Your tile smashing blew me away!

Thank you. However, I still have much to
learn. I’ll strive to keep improving.
Good attitude! Keep up the hard work!
All right! That wraps up today’s class! Osu!
episode_event_academy2026autumn/4004_110: After class, when the school day was over...
episode_event_academy2026autumn/4005_100: Osu! Let’s do our best tomorrow, too!

Since we worked out today, tomorrow’s
class will be mostly lecture!

Proper rest after a workout...
Seems reasonable.

I once pushed myself too hard. It was a
frustrating experience.

There’s no learning without hardship, but
it’s never good to overexert oneself.

That’s right! Hurting yourself won’t do you
any good!

What a relief... I don’t think I could do
another day like today!

Hahaha! It was my first class on Pasio,
so maybe I got a little too excited!

But great job keeping up! You’re all
amazing!

That reminds me—for tomorrow’s lecture,
we’re meeting at the schoolyard instead of
the classroom.
Yup, just how I like it!

It’s better that way! Hope you’re looking
forward to tomorrow!
episode_event_academy2026autumn/4006_100: Look at all these cuts and scrapes!
What did I tell you about being careful?!

S-sorry... I got a little too hot-blooded
during class...

But you got me feeling good and ready to
go again, Nurse Miriam!

Just make sure this doesn’t happen
again, OK?

Ms. Miriam saw that Ms. Dendra was hurt,
and she took care of her right away...

Maybe the strongest thing of all is the
kindness to support your friends!
*gasp* Is that the essence of battle studies?!

Ms. Dendra, did you hurt yourself on purpose
just to show us what true strength is?!
Uh...uh-huh! Exactly!
Ms. Dendra! I’m so moved!
So THAT’S what battle studies is all about!
Y-yup!
There’s no way you were thinking that!

Hahaha... It’s fine. Even if it is a
misunderstanding.

Nothing makes me happier as a teacher than
seeing my students’ passion.
I suppose I must agree.

You’re always a source of energy for me
too, Ms. Dendra.
Nurse Miriam! What kind words!

Hey, everyone! Let’s keep following Nurse
Miriam’s example of strength and kindness!
Yes!

Seeing those two just now really helped me
understand Ms. Miriam’s strength!
Urshifu looks fired up, too!
Let’s give it our all—together!
Yeah! That’s the spirit! Osu!
Osu!
Osu!
